summary: Fireworks AI's Nexus product is the best current instantiation of the hybrid multi-model enterprise architecture
summary_extended: Baker argues that Fireworks AI's Nexus product is currently the best broad instantiation of the hybrid multi-model enterprise architecture, which he views as the dominant future paradigm for enterprise AI deployment. Nexus enables enterprises to select a frontier model, fine-tune an open-source model on proprietary data via reinforcement learning, and route between them transparently — a capability set Baker sees as uniquely comprehensive. He notes that Fireworks CEO Lynn articulated this vision before Palantir's Karp and Microsoft's Nadella adopted similar language, suggesting Fireworks has a conceptual and product lead. The investment implication is complicated by Fireworks being a private company; Baker names Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JP Morgan, Fidelity, and a16z as target enterprise customers but does not present a direct public-equity trade. The thesis is primarily informational about a private company's product leadership, with Palantir and Microsoft cited only as lagging adopters of the same architectural language rather than as primary beneficiaries.
